reason: The official HM Land Registry search-service landing page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from generic retrieval guidance to access-control validation. It states that users must sign in to use the service; title register and title plan downloads are paid. Because this producer is restricted to official public no-login windows, target-specific title/register/plan content cannot be fetched here. No canonical parcel geometry/bbox is therefore asserted, and spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
